name: Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Ltd
business_description: Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Ltd manufactures and sells pig iron and ferrous castings, primarily used in automotive, tractor, and diesel engine applications. The company generates revenue by supplying these metal components to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and industrial customers who require them for engine and transmission assemblies.
key_products: Ferrous castings (cylinder blocks, cylinder heads, transmission parts, housings)
input_sensitivity: Cost risks include fluctuations in iron ore and coal prices, energy costs, and labour expenses, which directly impact manufacturing margins. Revenue and demand are highly sensitive to the production volumes and health of the domestic automobile, tractor, and diesel engine manufacturing sectors, as these industries drive direct demand for pig iron and ferrous castings.
output_note: OEMs and industrial manufacturers in the automotive, tractor, and diesel engine sectors pay Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Ltd directly for pig iron and ferrous castings used in their engine and transmission assemblies.
